idea-plugin.name: .NET Analysis&Refactoring MCP
idea-plugin.description:
An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that runs inside the ReSharper/Rider backend process, exposing code intelligence features to AI assistants via HTTP.

A fork of Joshua Light's MCP Server for Code Intelligence.

Available tools:

  • find_usages — Find all references to a symbol
  • get_symbol_info — Get detailed symbol info: kind, type, params, docs, base types
  • find_implementations — Find implementations of interfaces/abstract classes
  • get_file_errors — Get compile errors and unresolved references
  • search_symbol — Search symbols by name across the solution
  • go_to_definition — Navigate to a symbol's declaration with source text
  • get_solution_structure — List projects, target frameworks, and references
  • browse_namespace — Browse namespace hierarchy
  • list_symbols_in_file — List all declarations in a file
  • list_solutions — List all open solutions across Rider instances
  • fix_usings — Fix missing using directives in C# files
  • format_file — Format, clean up, or apply code style to a file
  • flow — Describe control flow of a method or type with execution steps, branches, and inlined calls
  • get_symbol_source — Get the full declaration source code of a symbol
  • get_call_hierarchy — Build an incoming/outgoing call hierarchy tree for a method
  • get_type_hierarchy — Get the inheritance hierarchy of a type (super/subtypes)
  • get_diagnostics — Run daemon inspections on a file and report diagnostics with quick-fix availability
  • list_quick_fixes — List available ReSharper quick-fixes at a position
  • apply_quick_fix — Apply a ReSharper quick-fix at a position (write)
  • rename_symbol — Semantic rename of a symbol and all references across the solution (write)
  • generate_members — Generate members on a type, e.g. constructors and overrides (write)
  • complete_at — Get code completion suggestions at a position
  • apply_suggestions — Apply inspection quick-fixes file-wide by id, e.g. convert to primary constructor (write)

Supports C#, F#, VB, and any language with a ReSharper PSI implementation.

Multi-solution support: multiple Rider instances can run simultaneously — all accessible through a single MCP endpoint. Use the list_solutions tool to discover open solutions and target tools with the solutionName parameter.

The MCP server starts automatically on http://127.0.0.1:23751/ when you open a solution. Set the DOTNET_ANALYSIS_AND_REFACTORING_MCP_PORT environment variable to use a different port.
idea-plugin.getting-started:
1. Configure your MCP client

Add to your MCP client config (e.g. Claude Code settings.json, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.):

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dotnet-analysis-and-refactoring": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:23751/"
    }
  }
}

2. Open a solution

The MCP server starts automatically when you open a solution in Rider. No extra setup needed.

3. Use the tools

Your AI assistant can now call tools like find_usages, get_symbol_info, search_symbol, and more — powered by ReSharper's code analysis engine.

Multiple solutions

When multiple Rider instances are open, all solutions are accessible through the same http://127.0.0.1:23751/ endpoint. Use list_solutions to see what's available, and pass solutionName to target a specific solution.

Custom port

Set the DOTNET_ANALYSIS_AND_REFACTORING_MCP_PORT environment variable before launching Rider to use a different port.
